answer: Work-slot bond burning blocks fake identities. Each agent claims one slot by posting a bond equal to twice its 30-day earnings, locked 20 epochs. A delta check compares work with its garden of past tasks: a mismatch, or a spiral of identical outputs across slots, freezes the bond to burn. Forging 100 identities costs 100 bonds, or 6,000 days of earnings, for zero payout. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps its slot, and earns undiluted rewards.
